title: FloodGuard Private Flood Policy Conditions: Late Renewal Charge
content:
**Condition — Late renewal charge.** A late-renewal charge is added to the renewal payment on a FloodGuard Private Flood Policy according to the calendar days from the new term's start date to the payment date:

1. when more than 15 days have passed, the charge is 1.25 USD multiplied by every calendar day from the new term's start date to the payment date;
2. when at least one day but no more than 15 days have passed, a single flat charge of 10 USD is added;
3. no charge is added when the payment is made on or before the new term's start date.

**Counting the days.** The count runs in calendar days from the new term's start date to the date the renewal payment is made. A payment on the start date itself counts zero days.

**Where the lines fall.**

| Calendar days from the new term's start date to the payment date | Late-renewal charge |
|---|---|
| Payment on or before the start date (zero days or fewer) | none |
| 1 | 10.00 |
| 15 | 10.00 |
| 16 | 1.25 multiplied by 16, which is 20.00 |
| 30 | 1.25 multiplied by 30, which is 37.50 |

**Reading the condition.** Once more than 15 days have passed, the charge is no longer the flat amount: every calendar day of the count is charged at 1.25, including the first 15. At 16 days the charge is therefore 1.25 multiplied by 16, which is 20.00.

*Hypothetical:* a new term starts on a 1 July and the renewal payment is made on 21 July of that year. Twenty calendar days have passed, which is more than 15, so the charge is 1.25 multiplied by 20, which is 25.00. Had the payment been made on 16 July (15 days), the charge would have been the flat 10.00; on 1 July or earlier, none.
